title.ja: 右四間飛車には６筋の取る順を読む
title.en: Read the Sixth-File Exchange Against Right Fourth File Rook

intro.ja: 後手の飛車が６筋へ寄ったら、６五の歩だけでなく、その後ろの銀・飛車と斜めから届く角を一緒に数えます。先手は金６七と銀７七を持つ矢倉でも、取る順番が変われば同じ守り方はできません。桂が７七を狙う形では、駒をかわす手と６六の歩が角道を塞ぐ役割も比べます。
intro.en: When Gote shifts the rook to the sixth file, count the silver and rook behind the pawn and any bishop joining from a diagonal. Sente's Yagura gold on 6g and silver on 7g do not guarantee the same response in every exchange. When a knight targets 7g, compare moving the silver with the role of the pawn on 6f as a bishop-line blocker.

question.ja: ６筋の歩交換を同じように取れなくなるのは、後手角３三がどの升に利きを増やした時ですか？
question.en: Which square becomes a new recapture point when Gote's bishop on 3c joins a sixth-file exchange?

answer.ja: ４四・５五が空いていれば、後手角３三は６六へ届きます。そこに先手金が進む交換では角による取り返しを追加で読み、先手角３九の６六への道と後手飛車６二の縦の道も続けて確認します。
answer.en: With 4d and 5e clear, Gote's bishop on 3c reaches 6f. If Sente's gold arrives there, add the bishop capture to the count, then check Sente's bishop route from 3i and Gote's rook's open file from 6b.

title.ja: ６六で銀と飛車の取り手が続く
title.en: The Silver and Rook Arrive in Sequence on 6f

text.ja: 先手玉８八・金７八と６七・銀７七を矢倉の芯に、角３九を６六への斜線上に置いた局面です。後手は飛車６二・歩６四・銀５四で６筋を攻めます。後手角４二の斜線は５三・６四や３三の方向で、６六を通らないため、６六の取り手には含めません。
text.en: Sente has the Yagura core of king 8h, golds 7h and 6g, silver 7g, with its bishop on 3i aimed toward 6f. Gote attacks with rook 6b, pawn 6d, and silver 5d. Gote's bishop on 4b runs along diagonals such as 5c–6d and 3c, none of which passes through 6f, so it does not count as a recapturer on 6f.

text.ja: 後手が歩を６五へ進め、先手歩６六が取った例です。先手に歩が入る一方、後手銀５四は６五へ斜め前に進めます。歩を取っただけで６筋の攻めが止まったとは言えません。
text.en: Gote advances the pawn to 6e and Sente's pawn from 6f captures it. Sente gains a pawn in hand, while Gote's silver on 5d can recapture on 6e. The pawn capture alone does not end the file attack.

text.ja: 後手銀が歩を取り、先手銀７七が６六へ出て銀６五を見ます。銀が６六に移ったため、後手銀は前方の６六で銀を取れます。先手はその後の金６七の取り返しまで読んでから、この配置を選びます。
text.en: Gote's silver takes the pawn; Sente's silver from 7g steps to 6f and attacks it. Gote's silver on 6e can capture the silver ahead on 6f. Sente must include the gold's next recapture before choosing this formation.

text.ja: 後手銀が先手銀を取り、金６七がその銀を取り返します。この時点で後手飛車６二から６六までの６三・６四・６五は空き、飛車が金を取る選択肢があります。
text.en: Gote's silver captures Sente's silver, and Sente's gold from 6g recaptures it. Squares 6c, 6d, and 6e are clear between Gote's rook on 6b and the gold on 6f, so the rook can choose to capture next.

text.ja: 後手が飛車で金を取った場合、先手角３九は４八・５七を通って６六の飛車を取れます。後手は飛車を差し出す義務がなく、別の応手もあります。この順は歩・銀・金・飛車・角の利きを実際に数えるための例です。
text.en: If Gote takes the gold with the rook, Sente's bishop from 3i captures the rook on 6f through 4h and 5g. Gote is free to keep the rook instead. The line is a concrete count of pawn, silver, gold, rook, and bishop recaptures, not a forced result.

title.ja: 角３三が６六に届けば前章の計算を変える
title.en: A Bishop on 3c Changes the Count

text.ja: ６筋の歩・銀・飛車と先手の矢倉は前章と同じですが、後手角は３三にいます。４四・５五が空いているので角は６六を見ています。先手金６七が６六に出た後の取り手を、ここで数え直します。
text.en: The sixth-file pawn, silver, rook, and Sente Yagura are as before, but Gote's bishop now sits on 3c. Empty 4d and 5e let it reach 6f. Recount the exchange after Sente's gold moves there.

text.ja: 後手歩を先手歩が取り、後手銀が取り返す例です。６五に後手銀がいる間、先手銀７七から６六へ出ると後手銀も６六へ取れます。
text.en: Sente's pawn takes Gote's pawn on 6e, and Gote's silver recaptures. A Sente silver move from 7g to 6f is available, but Gote's silver on 6e can capture it there.

text.ja: 銀同士の交換を金６七で取り返すと、先手金が６六に立ちます。今は飛車６二だけでなく角３三も６六を取れます。前章の飛車を角で取るだけの順とは、相手の選択肢が違います。
text.en: After the silver exchange, Sente's gold from 6g lands on 6f. Both Gote's rook on 6b and bishop on 3c can now capture there. The attacker has a choice absent from the previous position.

text.ja: 後手が角で金を取り、先手角が後手角を取り返しても、後手飛車が６六の角を取れます。ここで示したのは後手が選んだ交換順で、飛車まで差し出す前章の手順を機械的に当てはめてはいけないという比較です。駒の損得や最善手は他の応手も含めて判断します。
text.en: If Gote's bishop takes the gold, Sente's bishop can capture that bishop, and Gote's rook can then capture Sente's bishop on 6f. This is one defender-chosen sequence. It shows why the earlier rook-for-bishop calculation cannot be reused unchanged; judging the best move requires considering other replies too.

title.ja: 桂の目標７七と歩６六の遮りを分けて考える
title.en: Separate the Knight's Target from the Pawn's Bishop Block

text.ja: 後手桂８五は７七の銀へ跳ねられます。先手歩６六は後手角３三から７七への途中を塞ぎ、金６七は７七を取れます。この三つの関係を別々に確認してから、銀を動かすかを決めます。
text.en: Gote's knight on 8e can jump onto Sente's silver on 7g. Sente's pawn on 6f blocks Gote's bishop line from 3c toward 7g, and the gold on 6g can recapture on 7g. Check these three relationships separately before moving the silver.

text.ja: 銀７七を８六へかわす選択です。銀は桂の着地点７七から離れ、歩６六はそのまま角道を遮っています。ただし銀８六が他の駒に狙われないかも、実戦では確認が必要です。
text.en: Sente chooses to move the silver from 7g to 8f, off the knight's landing square. The pawn on 6f still blocks the bishop diagonal. In a real position, Sente must also check whether the relocated silver is safe.

text.ja: 後手が空いた７七へ桂を跳ねて成っても、先手金６七が成桂を取る例です。後手桂の着地点と金の利きを数え、６六の歩が角３三の追撃を遮っていることを確認します。後手はこの桂跳ねを選ばず、６筋で動くこともできます。
text.en: If Gote nevertheless jumps the knight to the vacated 7g and promotes, Sente's gold from 6g captures it. The pawn on 6f still blocks the bishop from following into 7g. Gote can choose a sixth-file move instead of this knight jump.

text.ja: 比較として先手がまず歩６六を６五へ進めた場合、後手桂は７七の銀を取って成れます。金で成桂を取っても角３三が開いた斜線から金を取り、先手玉８八はその馬を取り返せます。王手や玉の移動まで続くため、これを後手の必勝とも先手の必敗とも決めず、歩を動かす前の確認事項として扱います。
text.en: For comparison, if Sente first advances the pawn from 6f to 6e, Gote's knight can capture the silver on 7g and promote. Sente's gold takes the promoted knight, but the newly opened bishop line lets Gote capture that gold; Sente's king from 8h can then capture the horse. The line reaches a check and a king move, so it is a concrete warning about changed geometry, not proof of a forced win.
